note: In the Great North Woods 12 miles east of Colebrook, set back in the woods from Little Diamond Pond (boat launch, small boats at 10 mph). The campground and lodges connect directly to the Coos County ATV and snowmobile trail network. All campers check in at the lodge office; limited to no cell service. --Claude
summary: RA per-site catalog (23 campsites, 14 take 23 ft+, six 40-ft pull-throughs, no hookups), park page, 2022 info sheet, 2026 schedule (05-15 to 10-14, fall primitive year-round), $35 rate. Facilities confirmed incl. laundry and store. Not waterfront confirmed. OHV side flagged (ATV-accessible sites; a general state park campground). Phone discrepancy between the park page and RA.
flags: OHV (flag, not a drop): RA 'NO hook up sites at this campground. All sites are ATV trail accessible.'; park page 'With added ATV camping sites, riders are able to leave their campsite and head right out on the trails. Trails from Coleman State Park connect with the 1000 mile of trails for OHRV riding and Snowmobiling in Coos County' and 'The campground ... offers 29 campsites, including sites for ATV camping with direct trail access.' Read as a general state park campground (pond fishing, boat launch, lodges, hiking) with an OHV side, not a staging camp. Reviewer call.
